core:fertility_wish_tilt.source: tools/life_reference.py --wish-refit --accept --market (the --accept fit's values): bisection of alpha on the realized live births per woman reaching 50 in 24 closed towns of 1000 founders over 300 years (burn-in 100, seeds 1-24), bracket [0.239021, 0.239324]; checked on 48 new towns (seeds 900001-900048)
core:fertility_wish_tilt.note: ADR-0017, addendum of 2026-11-05: alpha under the wish of both partners, with the market of 11.2a; delete-one-town standard error 0.002

core:fertility_count_until.note: A child with a town birth second counts as young until the first month start of its 18 whole years, alive or not; a birth with no person in the town never leaves.

core:fertility_extra.note: She starts an attempt only while her live births are below her wish plus this: one extra child in her life, by a new partner's wish or a grown child; twins may finish one over.

core:fertility_grown_from.note: A grown child reopens her only with at least this many live births (the smallest whole number above the target of 2.20).

core:fertility_grown_chance.source: ADR-0017, addendum of 2026-11-05: a play value, held in the refit of alpha
core:fertility_grown_chance.note: A grown child reopens her only if her draw FERTILITY_WISH at occasion 1 (her key, the seed of her wish) is below this; his slot does not read it.

core:pairing_taste_sd.source: genetics specification 11.2a [K11.2j]; ADR-0018, addendum of 2026-11-06 (third round: 1 year)
core:pairing_taste_sd.note: sigma_nu: every person draws one taste nu ~ normal(0, sigma_nu) from PAIRING_TASTE, a pure function of its lineage key (pool persons with the pool seed, town-born with the world seed). It stands only in the target ages. A play value for both sexes, not fitted.

core:pairing_male_target_slope.note: His target age is his age a minus delta(a) = min(slope * max(a - from, 0), cap), not below the minimum: this is the years the target falls behind his own per year of age past the starting age. A play value for the modern scenario, not fitted.

core:pairing_male_target_from.note: The age in years from which the man's target age falls behind his own. A play value for the modern scenario, not fitted.

core:pairing_male_target_cap.note: The most the man's target age falls behind his own, in years (a man of 60 aims at 45, one of 70 at 55). A play value for the modern scenario, not fitted.

core:pairing_male_target_min.note: The lowest target age of a man before his taste, in years (a man from 16 to 21 aims at 21). A play value for the modern scenario, not fitted.

core:pairing_weight_age_male.source: genetics specification 11.2a [K11.2p]; ADR-0018, addendum of 2026-11-06 (third round)
core:pairing_weight_age_male.note: w_am, utility per squared year of the distance between her age and his target age in his answer, the same unit as core:pairing_weight_age. His answer has no trait term: U_m = -w_am * (a_f - t_m)^2 + G_m > 0. A play value, not fitted (third round of 2026-11-06); the stock share of couples with the older woman, 0.18, is carried by her weight w_a.
